title: Bidirectional Empowerment of Metamorphic Testing and Large Language Models: A Systematic Survey
reasoning: The paper is a systematic survey that includes a specific category for evaluating Fairness and Bias (Section 4.2.2), which covers studies on individual fairness, moral reasoning, and ethical alignment. It highlights the Reeq framework which utilizes moral philosophy for detecting ethical inconsistencies and discusses model alignment with ethical standards.
